title: Spurs agree £75m deal to sign Man City's Savinho
summary: Tottenham Hotspur have agreed to sign Manchester City winger Savinho for £75m with a further £10m in potential add-ons. The deal represents a significant investment as Spurs strengthen their attacking options for the upcoming season.
content: Tottenham agree a deal to sign Manchester City winger Savinho for £75m, with a further £10m in potential add-ons.
